name: Construction of Notre-Dame de Paris begins
summary: Bishop Maurice de Sully lays the foundation stone of Notre-Dame on the Île de la Cité in the presence of Pope Alexander III. Construction continues nearly two centuries; the great rose windows are completed under Louis IX in the 1250s.

_quarry.structural_significance: Defining monument of mature Gothic architecture; pioneers the flying buttress as a load-bearing element. Becomes both the ecclesiastical heart of the medieval French monarchy and a model for Gothic cathedrals from Reims to Cologne.
